# Kubota Wagyu Games

> Free Roblox games made by Kubota Chikusan (株式会社窪田畜産), a Wagyu cattle farm in Kirishima, Kagoshima, Japan. Themes: farming, Wagyu cows, eggs and cute animals, Japanese food (yakiniku, hamburger). Made for kids and families. English and Japanese, auto-translated to KO/ZH/ES/PT/ID.

## Games

- [Steal Animal Eggs! (どうぶつ卵どろぼう)](https://www.roblox.com/games/130036489376961): Steal eggs from the center nest, hatch cute animals and earn coins. Run on your treadmill to get stronger and faster, steal animals from other players' bases, and lock your base to protect your pets. Genre: Simulation, Tycoon. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/steal-animal-eggs.html
- [Egg Thief: Animal Run (卵どろぼう アニマルラン（2D）)](https://www.roblox.com/games/109908343225950): A simple 2D egg-stealing game. Sneak eggs, hatch animals on your farm, beat bosses, get stronger on the treadmill and rebirth for bigger rewards. Easy English for young players. Genre: Simulation, Idle. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/egg-thief-animal-run.html
- [Egg Guardians! (たまごガードマン)](https://www.roblox.com/games/129486975968092): Thieves are coming for your eggs! Place cute animal guards along the path - Chick, Bunny, Piggy, Sheep, Kubota Beef, Panda and Dragon - and upgrade them to level 5. A Boss Thief comes every 10 waves. Genre: Strategy, Tower Defense. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/egg-guardians.html
- [Moo Moo Ranch (うしうしランチ)](https://www.roblox.com/games/124577406804376): Raise cute cows and get rich! Buy cows, watch them grow and earn coins every second. Put two cows in the Love Barn to get rare babies like the Rainbow Cow and the Kubota Wagyu. Genre: Tycoon, Simulation. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/moo-moo-ranch.html
- [Wagyu Farm Life (和牛ファームライフ)](https://www.roblox.com/games/121425830065532): A realistic Japanese Wagyu cattle farming simulator made by a real Wagyu farm in Kagoshima, Japan. Cut grass, feed and care for your cows, breed calves, fatten and sell cattle, hire helpers, use tractors and build barns. Neglect your cows and they can get sick. Genre: Simulation, Farming. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/wagyu-farm-life.html
- [Find the Runaway Wagyu! (脱走した黒毛和牛をさがせ！)](https://www.roblox.com/games/87070592941283): Wagyu cows escaped into a Japanese shopping street! Team up, follow hoofprints and moos, and bring them back to the cow pen. Hungry cows follow feed, shy cows run if too many chase them, and a rare Golden Cow sometimes appears. Genre: Adventure, Co-op. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/find-the-runaway-wagyu.html
- [Yakiniku Boss Battle! (焼肉ボスバトル！)](https://www.roblox.com/games/84630089121683): Giant beef tongue and kalbi run around a Japanese yakiniku grill! Team up, chase them with tongs and push the meat onto the plate when it is cooked just right. Cook too long and the smoke turns your screen white. Genre: Action, Co-op. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/yakiniku-boss-battle.html
- [Escape the Hamburger Factory! (逃げろ！ハンバーグ工場)](https://www.roblox.com/games/111977220564579): You are food! Escape a crazy hamburger factory before you become a burger. Run on conveyor belts, jump over mixers, dodge giant presses and spatulas. New random stages every 3-5 minute round, and funny food costumes. Genre: Obby, Platformer. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/escape-the-hamburger-factory.html
- [Bus Crew! (みんなで一台 バスでGO!)](https://www.roblox.com/games/130654691856808): A friendly co-op game where up to 8 players ride one bus. Split the jobs - drive, repair, refuel, wipe windows, honk at cows and open doors at bus stops - and reach the goal together. No violence. Genre: Co-op, Driving. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/bus-crew.html
- [Runner & Builder (走る人と、道をつくる人)](https://www.roblox.com/games/82243594817644): A two-player co-op obby. One runs, one builds the path by placing blocks for the partner, then switch roles halfway. Don't fall in the lava! Genre: Obby, Co-op. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/runner-and-builder.html
- [Rock Paper Tag! (じゃんけんおにごっこ！)](https://www.roblox.com/games/129796311509019): Rock-paper-scissors tag with three teams. Rock catches Scissors, Scissors catches Paper and Paper catches Rock - chase one team while running from another! Genre: Party, Tag. Details: https://kiharamura-creator.github.io/kubota-wagyu-games/games/rock-paper-tag.html

## About the maker

- [Kubota Chikusan](https://www.kubota-chikusan.com/): Wagyu breeding and fattening farm, sells Kubota beef (窪田牛) in Kirishima, Kagoshima, Japan.
